bio.text: Salud Carbajal has represented California's 24th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2017.
Carbajal earned a bachelor's degree from UC Santa Barbara in 1990 and a master's degree from Fielding Graduate University in 1994, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve from 1984 to 1992.
Carbajal worked on the staff of Santa Barbara County Supervisor Naomi Schwartz from 1993 to 2004 and served on the county Board of Supervisors from 2004 to 2016.
Carbajal is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
